result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders, so your example gives Anna 2 and Bob 1.

- **Fix:** `DataStore.findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` (`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, around line 6518) was missing the `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` filter. I added it, matching the per-quarter and per-country purchase-order queries.
- **Test:** `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` has a new `leavesCancelledPurchaseOrdersOut` case covering your example. It also gained a status-taking overload of the `purchaseOrder` helper.

`SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes (4 tests, 0 failures). I did not run the full suite. Nothing is committed.
